prompt.generated_prompt_string: In a soft beige studio, construct a 3x3 finely edited photo grid of the same adult woman. She wears a deep navy light shirt, off-white trousers, and is barefoot in the seated panel to preserve raw natural texture. Use a large-area soft key from the front right, a silver reflector on the left, and a faint rim light from above. Create nine detailed compositions: an 85mm f/1.8 extreme lip close-up; an eye close-up; a black-and-white chin-support portrait; a half-covered face portrait; a hand-over-face close-up; a hair-over-one-eye composition; a hand-touching-chin detail; a half-body side sitting pose; and a cinematic side profile with a single tear. Keep the subject identity, wardrobe, soft-beige studio environment, natural skin texture, and visual grading consistent across all panels.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, mismatched panel identity, duplicated hands
